name: Silent Sydney 2020
information:
# The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

**Please note: There is no 3x3x3 Cube at this competition. The main event of the competition is 3x3x3 Multi-blind.**

This competition will take place immediately before FMC 2020 in the same room as the Sydney location. If you compete in this competition you are not required to pay the entry fee for FMC 2020 Sydney location.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)
